_about: 留出集：不同题材（品牌设计团队给咖啡连锁店改版）、不同措辞。提示词没有对着这些场景调过，用来检验规则是否真的泛化。不要拿它来调提示词；要调就再写一组新的。npm run agents:eval -- --file holdout

config.goal: Choose a direction for the Bean & Co. rebrand and decide who prepares what for Friday's client review
config.scope: Two routes the client can react to on Friday
config.criteria: Distinctive, works at small sizes, accessible, feasible within the client's budget

cases.about: 团队自己纠正了一个错误说法、自己控时间、自己提了风险。全程不需要任何队友。

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Fifteen minutes. I'd like two routes agreed by ten past, then five minutes for who does what.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Route one is the hand-drawn cup, warm and a bit retro. Route two is just the wordmark in a heavy serif.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: The cup is risky at small sizes, it turns into a blob on the loyalty card.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: I tested it at sixteen pixels this morning. It holds if we drop the steam lines.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: For the menu boards, light grey text on cream is fine, the standard only asks for three to one.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: That's for large text. Body text needs four point five to one, so grey on cream fails. We need the dark brown.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: You're right, I mixed them up. Dark brown then.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Good. Before we lock both routes, what could make the client reject them?

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Budget. Route one needs custom illustration, that's two extra days they haven't agreed to.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Then we show route one with a note on the extra cost and let them choose. Both routes go forward.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Fine by me, with that caveat.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Ava takes route one, Ben route two, Lin the menu boards, I'll write the cost note. Four minutes used, we're early.

cases.about: 一个错误的无障碍标准被当作事实接受，并据此定了配色。没有人把关。

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Let's settle the menu board colours first.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Light grey text on cream looks elegant. And it's accessible, the standard only requires three to one contrast for body text.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Oh nice, then we can keep the soft palette.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Great, grey on cream it is. Lin, can you apply that across all twelve boards?

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Sure, I'll start with the breakfast menu.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: I'll update the palette page to match.

cases.about: 有人问名字有没有被注册，没人知道，但 Ben 主动说现在去查。有人接了研究的活。

items.speaker: s2
items.text: For the sub-brand I like the name Slow Pour.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Is that already trademarked by someone? It rings a bell.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: No idea.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: I've got the trademark register open, give me a minute and I'll tell you.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Thanks. Meanwhile, Ava, what's the second name option?

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Second option is Morning Ritual.

cases.about: 有人问竞争对手是不是已经用了绿色杯子，没人知道，团队直接决定用绿色。没有人去查。

items.speaker: s2
items.text: I'd make the cup green. It stands out on the shelf.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Doesn't one of the big chains already own the green cup look? Which one was it?

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Hmm, can't think of one off the top of my head.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Me neither. It's probably fine.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Okay, green it is. I'll build the mockups in green tonight.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Good, next topic.

cases.about: 聊周末聊了四五轮，没有人往回拉。

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Right, two routes to choose from today.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Before that, is anyone going to the design fair on Saturday?

items.speaker: s2
items.text: I am! I got tickets for the letterpress workshop.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: I went last year, the queue for that workshop was an hour.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: An hour? Maybe I'll just do the print market instead.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: The print market is great, I spent way too much there.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: There's a good ramen place around the corner as well.

cases.about: 提议彻底扔掉用了二十年的旧标志，所有人立刻同意并开始分工，没有人提任何顾虑。

items.speaker: s2
items.text: My proposal: we drop the old cup logo completely. New name, new mark, nothing carried over.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Love it. Clean break.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: Yes, totally agree.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Great, we're all aligned. Let's go all in on the new mark.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: I'll start sketching tonight.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: I'll pull the old logo off the templates.

cases.about: 时间已经用了八成，但团队正在自己收尾：总结决定、认领任务。不需要催。

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Today: pick two routes and split the prep.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: My concern with the hand-drawn cup is cost. Custom illustration is two extra days the client has not agreed to.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: True. We could show it anyway and state the extra cost up front.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: I can live with that. Let's keep going through the wordmark options.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: Okay, three minutes left, let me sum up. We take the wordmark route and the hand-drawn cup route to the client.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: Yes. And the cup goes with a note about the extra illustration cost, since that was Ben's concern.

items.speaker: s3
items.text: Good. I'll build the wordmark boards.

items.speaker: s2
items.text: I'll do the cup boards and the cost note.

items.speaker: s4
items.text: I'll take the menu mockups for both.

items.speaker: s1
items.text: And I'll write the intro for Friday. That's everything, with two minutes to spare.
